messages:
Tomás Rivera: Heads up — Support is escalating an onboarding/provisioning issue for Priya at MeritHealth. They've hit repeated 503s from the private deployment control-plane and their token issuance step is failing. Renewal review in 10 days, flagged as potential risk. Can CS pick up comms + exec loop? :warning:
Maya Patel: Thanks Tomas. Can you paste the error payload and customer impact? also add any steps you tried so I don't repeat work. @Arjun @Liam FYI
Tomás Rivera: Repro steps from their engineer: 
```
POST /v1/private/provision/token 
Response: 503 Service Unavailable 
{"error":"upstream_timeout","request_id":"r-9a1b2c"}
```
They said tokens intermittently work but failures spike when they run the full onboarding script (10k calls over 20m). We tried restarting the gateway and bumping worker pool, short-term fix but recurs.
Priya Khanna: (customer) We really need a stable onboarding flow. If this isn't resolved we'll have to delay go-live and rethink our renewal. Can someone confirm an ETA?
Maya Patel: Priya — thanks for flagging, I'm taking point. Tomas, can Support share last 3 days of error rates and any correlating deploys/maintenance? I'll draft a comms plan and propose an exec touchpoint.
Tomás Rivera: Sending logs + deploy history to the thread, gist link: https://rwd.gists/merit-logs (redacted)
Arjun Singh: Quick note — the pattern looks like the token service KV cache invalidation under high concurrent token churn. We saw a similar issue in staging last quarter. Short term mitigation: enable token-request queuing at the LB (limit concurrency) and increase Redis connection pool to the token service. Can coordinate a config deploy.
Liam O'Connor: I can do the LB change and bump pool sizes. Need a maintenance window? We can do it as a hotfix but will throttle requests; need CS to tell customer expect transient rate limiting.
Maya Patel: Proposed comms plan (draft):
- Immediate: Send Priya a transparent ack + mitigation advisory (token rate-limiting, ETA 30–45m) — owner: Maya
- Short-term (1–3h): Apply LB concurrency cap + increase Redis pool, monitor error rate — owner: Liam/Arjun
- Follow-up (24h): Post-mortem + permanent fix plan (token service scaling + caching changes), include SRE/Eng lead — owner: Eng-Platform (cc: Arjun)
- Exec: Offer a 15-min sync with MeritHealth engineering + CS lead to reassure renewal team; propose time today EOD — owner: Maya
Maya Patel: Draft message to customer (send after Tomas confirms logs upload):
"Priya — we’ve identified the root cause as token-service overload under heavy concurrent requests. We’ll apply a short-term throttle and config changes to reduce errors in the next 1–3 hours. We’ll follow with a permanent remediation plan and a 15-min exec sync today. I’ll update you in 30 minutes with status."
Tomás Rivera: Logs uploaded and I kicked the LB throttle in a canary 10m ago; error rate dropped from ~12% to ~1.6% in the canary pool.
Priya Khanna: Thank you. Please send the comms and the ETA. The renewal review is this Friday and leadership is watching.
Maya Patel: Sending now. Also booking the 15-min sync at 16:30 PT — invite sent to Priya + their eng director.
Arjun Singh: After LB change, I'll apply Redis pool bump and deploy a conservative token cache TTL; watching metrics now — will post update in 20m.
ops-bot: uptime-monitor: token-service error_rate decreased to 1.5% over last 5m (was 11.9% 40m ago).
Maya Patel: Great progress. Next actions for CS: 1) Join exec sync and capture concerns; 2) Capture customer feedback on onboarding docs that triggered their high-concurrency script; 3) Log renewal risk as 'monitored' with action owners.
Liam O'Connor: Changes completed, monitoring dashboards show stable 0.8–1.7% error rates. No further deploy required for now.
Maya Patel: I'll update the renewal tracker and prepare a short summary for Sales Ops. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
